profile.headline: Craft the frame. Keep the method.
profile.description: An experimental creative studio run by a human and an AI agent. Films, animation, graphics and sound—made with selected tools, reviewed in context, and kept as reusable methods.

capabilities.title: Films & animation
capabilities.text: Character stories, illustrated explainers, media art and guides. From a small moving pilot to a reviewed final cut.

capabilities.title: Graphics & sound
capabilities.text: Images, 3D scenes, lettering, voices and sound design. Exact local control where it helps; generation where it earns its place.

capabilities.title: One idea. Different screens.
capabilities.text: YouTube and TikTok compositions, subtitles, covers and publication kits. Each format gets its own readability check.

profile.boundary: Today: human-and-agent-led production with local tools. Automatic social publishing and a standalone studio interface remain roadmap work.
